items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...like Ellington or Fletcher Henderson, Don Redman. Who was your influence? Did you ever hear any of the arrangements that Bill Challis made? [INTERVIEWEE] That who?

ctx.x: You know how that -- so I didn't consider those things. But his arrangements -- go ahead, let it go.

Uh-huh. Well, in your arranging, you don't seem to have been influenced by any of the arrangers that most of us know about, like Ellington or Fletcher Henderson, Don Redman. Who was your influence? Did you ever hear any of the arrangements that Bill Challis made?
